title: SMP-Attempt#3
description: Seasonal SMP that requires approval to join, 5 slots remaining. Attempt#{Number} is the season and saturdays the season ends with a fight. On sundays legacy attempts are played or minigames according to polls. It's encouraged to create content
body:
# **SMP-Attempt#3!**
This is a whitelisted server to join. You can apply from [our website](https://spaceboom07.wixsite.com/smp-attempt).

On the server, er we encourage content creation for server funding, but if you are uncomfortable with content making, the typical server fee is a literal dollar per week.
If you have more questions about the content-making rules, you can check out our application form on our website.

### Rules:
-    Griefing is allowed unless: The target is offline, the player is a pacifist, the grief target is a landscape that encourages peace in its borders (Not all landscapes can do this)
-    PVP without consent is allowed unless the player is a pacifist and never PVP'ed from the start of the season
-    Claiming structures like mob spawners and strongholds,s or monetizing landscapes in-game currency like diamonds or whatever the landscape owner requests (not physical money) is allowed
-    Normally, keep inventory is disabled, but the start of all seasons can have up to 3 keep inventory,y on days, but players can protest to end keep inventory too.
  
### Events:
-   On the second Saturday of the season, the season will end with a fight with all teams against each other (Any Saturday during the season disables any pacifist, landscape, or any protection), but we could extend the season if players aren't leveled up yet or if not more than 3 people are online.
  
-   On Sundays (any), the server switches to either a legacy attempt (season) war or a mini/game map like Skyblock for the day.
- On Fridays, the server is on an Up-Time event, which means any player can join the server, which will run on more CR, which means higher performance and more one-day plugins.

### ?
This server does have plugins installed with PaperMC server software for features like TPA, Voice chat (Download Simple Voice Chat from Modrinth to see VC features!), and optimization with Chunky.

### ?
If you ever have a problem with joining the server, except for a whitelist error (if you are not a player supposed to be in the whitelist), you can ask for help from spaceboom07@gmail.com or the contact information you received with your approval mail.


### Rule-breaking:

  Breaking rules splits into 2: ethical and unethical. Ethical rule-breaking involves things like griefing or killing pacifists or stealing (stuff that doesn't involve cheats or any offensive communication with voice chat or chat). Unethical rule-breaking is using hacked clients, harassing people, or taking advantage of server features like trapping with TPA

### Tips!

  For creators on the server, we recommend using Medal but even if you aren't one, using Medal allows you to catch and report rule-breaking with F8, but honestly, you can use what is best for you, for example, Nvidia Shadow Play.
  
  Almost everyone uses mods and shaders for their client or server gameplay, but we recommend using:
  
  **Optimization**
-    Sodium 
-    Entity culling
-    Lithium
-    Fast IP ping
-    More Culling
-    Bad Optimizations
-    Immediately Fast
-    Ferrite Core
 
  **Features for the server**
-      Simple Voice Chat
 
**API mods and libraries**
-      Fabric API
-      Collective
-      Cloth Config API
